attributed_theory: Gil Marer states that no invitation or pre-meeting knowledge of the 4-February-2022 meeting reached his relevant perimeter and that no direct Community ACTA communication was received; he states that the Thompson family forwarded the ACTA indirectly only after the meeting. Gil and Aweswell allege that later actors separately adopted or extended a post-7-June-2018 control mechanism across insolvency-estate and non-estate rights and deliberately concealed the meeting until it was held. Every actor, act, offence element, knowledge state, causal contribution and defence remains separate; the native forwarding route and intentional non-notice are not established by the current ACTA copy.
not_arithmetic_rule: The case is not proved by adding the Community works budget, RICPE/RIC finance, eligible investment, subsidy, FEDER support or revenue. The test is whether materially overlapping units, works, invoices, jobs, authority and value were knowingly reused, inconsistently described, insufficiently disclosed or claimed across separate legal tracks, and whether a specific false act caused a patrimonial or public-funds decision.

boundaries: A continuing consequence is not automatically a continuing offence.
Luchy Playa Blanca, S.L.U. was the debtor in Concurso 36/2012; Matkator, S.L.U. and third-party property were outside LPB's estate.
De facto material, access and operational control is source-supported; whole-hotel legal possession by CAM was not judicially delivered.
The 2018 provisional dismissal and appellate confirmation are mandatory adverse procedural evidence.
Later title does not retroactively validate earlier control, works, debt, voting or extraconcursal acts.
A 20.993% attendance figure and publicly visible non-LPB/non-Matkator representatives do not prove deliberate non-notice or concealment.
The repository presently contains the located seven-page ACTA copy, not the native 4-February convocation/invitation and owner-by-owner service package.

Gil's corrected account is no direct invitation or ACTA communication followed by indirect post-meeting Thompson forwarding; it is not a claim that the ACTA was never obtained, and the native forward/upstream distribution remain open.

The alleged pattern from at least 2016 applies to particular meetings or attempts and must be tested event by event; the known and attended 26-April-2016 meeting prevents a universal concealment formulation.
A procedurally defective call or failed service does not by itself prove criminal intent; attribution requires an identified actor, knowledge, purpose, use and legally relevant effect.
The published four-sibling image is a preservation and knowledge-inquiry lead; it does not by itself prove Sun Park content, the photograph date, notice knowledge, agreement or an offence.
RICPE/RIC, regional incentives, FEDER and owner contributions are separate legal and accounting tracks; blended finance can be lawful.
‘Hotel mobbing’ is Gil/Aweswell's attributed umbrella label, not a standalone offence; every episode requires its own historical offence elements and actor-specific proof.

LPB assets were formally subject to insolvency-administration and judicial-supervision safeguards whose practical effectiveness is disputed; this is a protection architecture, not a guarantee. Matkator remained outside it.

De facto administrator or shadow-director status is not established by influence, office, kinship or benefit alone; discrete functional control and the full date-specific legal test must remain separate.

canonical_propositions.proposition: The 18 May 2018 Owners' Community minutes record an LPB/insolvency-administration-linked security and access proposal but do not facially transfer whole-hotel possession to CAM.
Concurso 36/2012 concerned LPB and did not absorb the entire mixed-ownership Sun Park hotel, Matkator property or every operating right.
The ONA-centred operating and financed-exit architecture was integrated and developed; completion, condition satisfaction and precise non-closing causation remain open.

A located seven-page copy records a 4 February 2022 Owners' Community meeting approving the sole CAM/JDAM project, licence actions, common works and unitary operation; it is not the diligenced original or a certified copy.
The 4 February 2022 copy records 20.993% present or represented; complete notice, ownership, powers, proxy, vote, abstention and conflict validity remain open.
The controlled owner-annex reading attributes EUR 1,199,729.12 Community debt and EUR 3,260,416.81 of the works levy to LPB; root-of-debt and enforceability remain open.

The meeting calls CAM the principal interested majority owner while the controlled allocation still uses LPB's 72.976% coefficient, creating an ownership-date and authority contradiction requiring reconciliation.

Gil Marer states that no invitation or pre-meeting knowledge reached his relevant perimeter and alleges that call design, selective or omitted service, concealment until after the meeting, resolutions, ACTA construction, no direct communication and later use formed one deliberate exclusion sequence directed against LPB/Matkator/Aweswell-side interests. The located ACTA proves what was recorded as a decision instrument; the current repository lacks the native invitation/service package and does not yet establish the lawful recipient, service failure, identified human act or intent.

Gil Marer states that the Thompson family forwarded the ACTA to his perimeter only after the meeting. This corrects any claim that the ACTA was never obtained: the controlled allegation is no direct Community communication followed by indirect third-party receipt. Native message, exact time, upstream distribution and attachment hash comparison remain open.

Gil Marer identifies the published image left-to-right as Javier, Laura Patricia, José Daniel and Gerardo Zacarías Acosta Matos. Independent corporate records corroborate that the four named people occupied governance roles in the relevant corporate perimeter, but do not identify the pixels. The image supports preservation and prior-knowledge inquiry, not a finding of deliberate exclusion, agreement or criminality.

Community cost allocation, RICPE/RIC finance, regional incentives, FEDER and current operation are separate legal tracks. Their evidentiary significance depends on unit/work/invoice/job/authority overlap and disclosure, not arithmetic aggregation.

deliberate_exclusion_proof_model.question: What can, does and could prove deliberate exclusion?
does_now: The located ACTA proves that a meeting was recorded for 4 February 2022 with 20.993% present or represented and records resolutions on debt, the sole CAM/JDAM project, common works, licences and unitary operation.

Its visible company representatives are Javier Acosta Matos for Construcciones Acos-Matos, Laura Acosta Matos for CAM and José Acosta Matos for Proyectos Acosta Matos; the remaining public attendee names are redacted.
The timing is 17 days before deed 457 of 21 February 2022, and the ACTA is therefore capable of being tested as an implementation instrument rather than treated as an isolated arithmetic record.

Separately from the ACTA, Gil Marer's direct account states no invitation or pre-meeting knowledge and indirect Thompson-family forwarding of the ACTA only after the meeting; the native relay evidence remains open.
does_not_now: The ACTA is not the native invitation, owner address list, service certificate, returned-mail record, fallback-notice record or post-meeting ACTA delivery ledger.
The redacted public attendee list cannot exclude an LPB or Matkator proxy.
Low attendance, aligned visible attendance, an irregularity, lack of direct communication or third-party receipt alone cannot identify the human decision-maker or prove criminal intent.
capable_of_proving_intent_when_convergen: proof of the legally correct LPB and Matkator notice recipients and statutory addresses known to the convener or administrator
native owner-list versions, mail merge, email headers, postal certificates, delivery/return records and notice-board fallback demonstrating selective service or deliberate omission

deliberate_exclusion_proof_model.criminal_boundary: If actor-specific knowledge, purpose, false representation or abuse of entrusted power and a legally relevant patrimonial, procedural or public-funds effect are proved, the sequence may support offence analysis. A civil/LPH defect, association, surname, office or numerical coincidence does not itself establish a crime. No future fact can be guaranteed to prove intent; the issue is whether the convergent package excludes innocent failure to the applicable standard.
